[[File:Professor Telesu.png|thumb|250px|Professor Telesu]] '''Professor Telesu''' (Japanese: '''テレス博士''' ''Dr. Telesu'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP260|A Crowning Achievement]]''. He is an archaeologist who was studying hieroglyphics near a lake full of {{p|Slowpoke}} that suffered a drought after an earthquake. According to the hieroglyphics, a Slowpoke needed to evolve into a {{p|Slowking}} to save the colony, but the {{p|Shellder}} in the lake kept on latching on to the Slowpoke and causing them to evolve into {{p|Slowbro}}. [[Alice Telesu|His daughter]]'s Slowpoke was able to make it, and was intelligent enough to lead the Slowpoke and Slowbro into an underground cave where water was plentiful. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{water color}}|bordercolor={{psychic color light}} |ja=相沢正輝 ''[[Masaki Aizawa]]'' |en=[[Dan Green]] |fr_eu=Jean-Marc Delhausse |it=Stefano Albertini |es_eu=Juan Antonio Arroyo |pt_br=Figueira Júnior |pl=Ireneusz Machnicki}}
